alloy: all a: Axiom | (some v: Unit | cites[a, v] and v not in Axiom) implies a in Misnesting
all f: Fact | (some u: Unit | cites[f, u]) implies f in Misnesting
all s: Spec | (some u: Unit | cites[s, u] and u not in Axiom and u not in Spec and u not in Fact) implies s in Misnesting
all e: Exception | (some u: Unit | cites[e, u] and u not in Spec and u not in Fact) implies e in Misnesting
all b: Bug | (some Runner and not tested[b]) implies b in Untesting
all c: Conflict | hidden[c] implies c in Finding
all c: Conflict | (some Tracker and (no i: Issue | c->i in Name.issue)) implies c in Untracking
all t: Test | adrift[t] implies t in Finding
all t: Test | (t in Declared and (no g: Tag | t->g in Carry.rel)) implies t in Uncitation
all t: Test | (t in Declared and (some u: Unit | checks[t, u] and u not in Claim)) implies t in Misaiming
(all a, b: Document | a->b in Extend.rel implies b->a in Context.rel) and (all a, b, c: Document | (a->b in Extend.rel and b->c in Extend.rel) implies c->a in Context.rel)
doubt: Read literally: the extending document is context for the one it extends (Context.rel x->y means y is context for x). One might expect the reverse direction (the extended document is context for the extender). 'Transitive through extension' read as: along a chain of extensions, the first document is context for the last.

alloy: all f: Fence, u: Unit | (f in Languaged and f->u in Within.rel) implies u->f in Blocks.rel
all f: Fence | f not in Languaged implies (no u: Unit | u->f in Blocks.rel)
all f: Fence | f in VocabularyWord implies f in VocabularyBlock
no Tracker implies (all u: Unit | u not in Untracking)

all r: Run | ((some f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p]) or (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) or (some c: Command | r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) or (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits2
doubt: The first two conditions are not tied to the run; read as holding anywhere in the project.

alloy: all p: Plugin, d: Document | (applies[p, d] implies p->d in Over.rel) and ((d not in Given and p->d in Over.rel) implies applies[p, d])
all f: Unclosed | f in Refused
all f: Unterminated | f in Refused
all f: Doubled | f in Refused
all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies (c in Unknown and r in Exits2)
all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies c in Unknown
all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies r in Exits2
all a, c: Document | (a != c and (some b: Document | b->a in Bare.rel and b->c in Bare.rel)) implies (a in Finding iff c in Finding)
doubt: 'Differ only in frontmatter' read as: the same document is each of them without its frontmatter.

alloy: some a: Axiom, s: Spec, t: Test, g: Tag, d: Document, i: Index | s->a in Sit.rel and t in Declared and t->g in Carry.rel and g->s in Name.tag and d->a in Hold.units and d->s in Hold.units and d->i in Hold.indexes and i->d in Match.rel and no Finding
some b: Bug, i: Issue, t: ExpectedFailure | b->i in Name.issue and i in Known and i not in Closed and checks[t, b] and b not in Finding and t not in Finding
some c: Conflict, i: Issue, u1, u2: Unit | u1 != u2 and c->i in Name.issue and i in Known and i not in Closed and c->u1 in Name.between and c->u2 in Name.between and c not in Finding
all u: Unit | (u in Wordless or u in Twofold) implies u in Unsayable
all u: Unit | u in Wordless implies u in Unsayable
all u: Unit | u in Twofold implies u in Unsayable
all r: Run, u: Unit | (r->CheckCommand in Ask.rel and u in Reported) implies r not in Exits0
all r: Run | r->GenerateCommand in Ask.rel implies ((all u: Unit | u in Handwritten implies u in Reported) and ((some u: Unit | u in Handwritten) implies r not in Exits0))
doubt: 'if there is one' read as: if some unit's statement is handwritten.

alloy: all r: Run, g: GenerateCommand, u: Unit | (r->g in Ask.rel and u in Unsayable) implies (u in Explained and r not in Exits0)
all w: Word | (w in Undeclared or w in Misplaced or w in Apart or w in Unused) implies w in Flagged
all d1, d2: Document, u: Unit | (d1 in Checked and d2 not in Checked and d1->d2 in Context.rel and d2->u in Hold.units) implies u not in Rewritten
all d1, d2: Document, u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (d1->u1 in Hold.units and u1->w in Voice.rel and d1->d2 in Context.rel and d2->u2 in Hold.units and u2->w in Introduce.rel) implies w not in Undeclared
(all u: Unit | u in Contradicting implies u in Named) and (all s: Scenario | s in Impossible implies s in Raised)
all s: Impossible, u: Unit | u->s in Frees.rel implies s->u in Blame.rel
all s: Scenario, u: Unit | s->u in Blame.rel implies u->s in Frees.rel
all u: Unit | u in Contradicting implies u in Named
all u1, u2: Unit | (u1 in Contradicting and u1->u2 in Together.rel) implies u2 in Named
all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies (u in Logical and u not in Term and w in Signature and loneOn[u, w])
all u, v: Unit, w: Word | (v != u and v->w in Utter.rel) implies u->w not in Expose.rel
all u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | u2->w in Picture.rel implies u1->w not in Expose.rel
all s: Series | (s in OneLineRule and s not in TimeFirst) implies s in OneLine
all d: Definition | (d in GuardedByKind and byKind[d]) implies d in PhrasePerKind
all d: Definition | (d in SameKindTwice and byKind[d]) implies d in JoinedWithOr
all q: Quantifier | q in NothingToAttach implies q in InFull
all q: Quantifier | q in NoWithAnother implies q in InFull
all q: Quantifier | q in TimedCondition implies q in InFull
all s: Series | s in NotClause implies s in AsBullets
all s: Series | s in AndInOr implies s in KeepsAndApart
all s: Series | (s in OneLineRule and s in TimeSecond and s not in TimeFirst) implies s in KeepsThen
all s: Series | (s in OneLineRule and s not in TimeFirst and s not in TimeSecond) implies s in DropsThen
some s: Series | s in Few and s in MoreThanTwo and s in CommaItem
some s: Series | s in Few and s in TooLong
doubt: 'can' read as a possibility (some such list exists).

alloy: some s: Series | s in SharedSubject and s in Many
some o1, o2: Owner, f: Failing | o2 in o1.handler and eventually (dispose[o1] and f->o1 in on and eventually (runNow[f] and eventually f->o2 in reached))
doubt: 'its error eventually reaches owner_2' read with the reached relation (the error of f has reached o2) rather than the report event.
